question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Vaguely
solution:
The correct answer is **Distinctly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vaguely** refers to a manner that is not precisely stated, understood, identified, or decided.

 
 
• **Example: ***He had thought only vaguely about his career at that point.*
 
 
 
• *​***Distinctly** refers to something extremely clear or easily seen.
 
 
• **Example:** *Lectures of our teacher could be heard quite distinctly.*
 
 

​Therefore, the words "Vaguely" and "Distinctly" have very different meanings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marginally** refers to a very slight margin.
 
• **Distractedly** refers to doing something while not paying attention to it because you are thinking or fretting about something else.
 
• **Uncertainly** refers to a state in which you are unsure of your actions, beliefs, or ability to make decisions.
